.²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a city, the modern {#ujjayinI#}, one of the seven sacred cities
 of the Hindus, to die at which is said to secure eternal happiness; <ab>cf.</ab>
 {#ayoDyA maTurA mAyA kASI kAYciravantikA . purI dvArAvatI cEva saptEtA#}
 {#mokzadAyikAH ..#} The women of Avanti are said to be very skilful in all
 erotic arts; <ab>cf.</ab> {#Avantya eva nipuRAH sudfSo ratakarmaRi#} <ls>B. R. 10. 82</ls>.
.²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a river. {%m.%} (<ab>pl.</ab>) <ab>N.</ab> of a country and its inhabitants; its
 capital being {#ujjayinI#} on the river {#siprA#}; and there is also the
 temple of {#mahAkAla#} in the suburbs. [According to Hemacandra {#avanti#}
 is synonymous with Mālava or the modern Mālavā; but the latter country
 covered in ancient times, as now, a wider area than Avanti, as Bāṇa
 applies the name to a neighbouring kingdom in the east, whose capital was
 Vidiśā on the Vetravatī or Betvā. In the time of the Mahābhārata
 Avanti appears to have extended on the south to the banks of the Narmadā
 and on the west probably to the banks of the Myhe or Mahī]; {#avantinATo'yamudagrAbAhuH#}
 <ls>R. 6. 32</ls>; {#asO mahAkAlaniketanasya vasannadUre kila candramOleH#} <ls n="R.">6. 34</ls>, <ls n="R. 6.">35</ls>;
 {#prApyAvantInudayanakaTAkovidagrAmavfdDAn#} <ls>Me. 30</ls>; {#avantIzUjjayinI#}
 {#nAma nagarI#} <ls>K. 52</ls>.

sour gruel (prepared from the fermentation
 of rice-water {#kAYjikam#}).
